about_the_game:
Did you skip your bath yesterday? Welcome to the Bath Cancellation Surveillance Committee!

In this town, a terrifying phenomenon known as the "Shower Skip" has spread…! Talk to NPCs and find out who’s skipping their showers. When you identify them, it's time to cleanse them—no mercy! But don’t think it’s just a simple game! Suddenly, cars may fall from the sky, or NPCs might be wielding diamond swords for no reason! Unexpected events happen non-stop, leaving you shouting, "What is going on here!?" This chaotic, clean-themed, ridiculous game is born!

Make sure you don’t miss it—add it to your wish list right now!

Once, this town was the cleanest in the world. Everyone bathed every day, and the world was enveloped in endless bubbles.

But then, something strange happened. The "bath-skipper" community emerged. They adamantly refuse to admit it—they "haven’t taken a bath"—and they are everywhere!

Your mission is to identify and cleanse these bath-skipper NPCs, but be careful, they are cleverly hiding.

Let's level up and unlock new abilities. Use sprinting, swords, guns, and the mini-map to your advantage as you cleanse the Shower Cancelation Community.

Why are people suddenly rejecting baths? There’s a hint of conspiracy in the air—wait, no, it smells…?

Uncover the truth and bring the town back to its sparkling cleanliness!

Game Features:

  • Simple but Hilarious Gameplay: The main goal is to find bath-skipper NPCs and cleanse them. As you play, unpredictable and wacky events happen, and you’ll constantly be shouting, "What’s going on!?" while laughing and enjoying the chaos.

  • Accessible to Casual Gamers: With a simple gameplay mechanic ("find the bath-skippers and cleanse them") and plenty of hilarious, unexpected moments, you don’t need deep strategy or complex controls to have fun.

  • Short, Fun Sessions: The game is designed for quick, easy-to-pick-up-and-play sessions, so you can enjoy a laugh without needing to spend hours learning complex mechanics.

  • Cleansing Challenge: Embark on a journey over 10 in-game days to track down bath-skipping NPCs. The game’s difficulty is low, and it's all about having fun while discovering and cleansing bath-skipper characters.

FAQ

Q: What is the goal of the game?
A: Your mission is to find NPCs who are skipping their baths and cleanse them! Along the way, unpredictable events happen, and you’ll need to keep your wits about you while turning the town back into a clean place.

Q: How can I identify the bath-skipper NPCs?
A: Bath-skipper NPCs are hiding throughout the town. Watch for strange behavior or suspicious actions, and when you spot them, begin cleansing to remove them from the streets!

Q: How long is the game?
A: The game lasts for 10 in-game days, and while the exact length is still being determined, it’s designed to provide enough content to enjoy without overstaying its welcome.

Q: What is the difficulty level like?
A: The game is intended to be a casual, fun "smart-aleck game," so the difficulty isn’t very high. It’s designed for intuitive play and laughter, not intense challenges.

Q: Will it support controllers?
A: Yes, the game will support both keyboard & mouse and controller.

Make sure you don’t miss it—add it to your wish list right now!

Title: Did You Take a Bath Yesterday? 2: The Smart-aleck Action Game

Genre: Casual, Action, Indie

Publisher: Nosan

Planned Release Date: 2025 (Exact Date TBD)

Planned Price: 4$
